cards.name: Winter, Tormented Loner
cards.oracle_text:
When Winter enters, you may sacrifice a creature or planeswalker. When you do, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
Winter gets +1/+0 for each creature and planeswalker card in your graveyard.

cards.name: Tinybones, Pocket Nuisance
cards.oracle_text:
When Tinybones enters, each opponent discards a card.
Whenever a player discards one or more cards, Tinybones deals 1 damage to each opponent.

cards.name: Festering March
cards.oracle_text:
Creatures your opponents control get -1/-1 until end of turn. Exile Festering March with three time counters on it.
Suspend 3—{2}{B} (Rather than cast this card from your hand, you may pay {2}{B} and exile it with three time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.)

cards.name: Okiba-Gang Shinobi
cards.oracle_text:
Ninjutsu {3}{B} ({3}{B}, Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.)
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player discards two cards.

cards.name: Beetle-Headed Merchants
cards.oracle_text: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cards.name: Necromancy
cards.oracle_text:
You may cast this spell as though it had flash. If you cast it any time a sorcery couldn't have been cast, the controller of the permanent it becomes sacrifices it at the beginning of the next cleanup step.
When this enchantment enters, if it's on the battlefield, it becomes an Aura with "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Necromancy." Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control and attach this enchantment to it. When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, that creature's controller sacrifices it.

cards.name: Ossuary Rats
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, it deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.

cards.name: Spark Harvest
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or pay {3}{B}.
Destroy target creature or planeswalker.

cards.name: Stab
cards.oracle_text: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.

cards.name: Elephant-Rat
cards.oracle_text: Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
